saved_formal_audit_review.note: Rechecked saved audit bindings, group equality and exact-position traces; no new author execution.

definitions.positions: truth_id:zero-based word index; all 320 main tokens and 7 positions in each twin history retained
definitions.candidate_count: Distinct full historical-normalized training word strings with the same exact character multiset, not frequency or modern species/name counts
definitions.training_word_status: Membership in the frozen 8000-token corpus of the true language
definitions.training_bag_status: At least one original training word has that exact multiset; singleton restoration included
definitions.missing_bag: Original decoder falls back to the alphabetically sorted bag. Coincidental exact words remain correct but are not learned coverage.
definitions.error_attribution: Descriptive partition by availability. Not a causal estimate of errors removable by more data or a better context model.

limitations: Only true-language/true-key diagnosis is attributed. Primary route/key errors are outside this partition.
Same-book test windows were historically exposed; no new blind or cross-author evidence.
An in-vocabulary wrong output is a candidate-selection error, not proof that context modeling alone caused it.
Do not add the observed missing target words to a lexicon and reuse these scores as a held-out result.
C01 histories share one ciphertext and one decoder output; 14 history-specific positions are not 14 independent test tokens.
No language, semantics or Voynich decipherment conclusion follows.
conditional_next_step: For the true-key decoder alone, prioritize a pre-fixed larger training/lexicon source and genuinely disjoint evaluation to test coverage, while retaining all same-bag candidates and OOVs. Keep vocabulary and context-model changes separate; preserve the frozen 320-token results as exposed development evidence. The full pipeline additionally needs its route/key limitations assessed separately.
